name: recruitment-platform
description: 面向中小企业的轻量化招聘协同工作台

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && nohup npm run start > ../backend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && nohup npm run dev > ../frontend.log 2>&1 &
scripts.start: npm run start:backend && sleep 3 && npm run start:frontend
scripts.stop:backend: PORT=$(grep BACKEND_PORT .env | cut -d'=' -f2) && pid=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t | head -n1) && if [ -n "$pid" ]; then cwd=$(ps -o cwd= -p "$pid" | xargs) && cmd=$(ps -o command= -p "$pid") && case "$cwd" in "$(pwd)"/*) kill "$pid" && echo "Stopped backend PID: $pid" ;; *) echo "skip kill: cwd=$cwd cmd=$cmd" ;; esac; else echo "Backend not running"; fi
scripts.stop:frontend: PORT=$(grep FRONTEND_PORT .env | cut -d'=' -f2) && pid=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t | head -n1) && if [ -n "$pid" ]; then cwd=$(ps -o cwd= -p "$pid" | xargs) && cmd=$(ps -o command= -p "$pid") && case "$cwd" in "$(pwd)"/*) kill "$pid" && echo "Stopped frontend PID: $pid" ;; *) echo "skip kill: cwd=$cwd cmd=$cmd" ;; esac; else echo "Frontend not running"; fi
scripts.stop: npm run stop:frontend && npm run stop:backend
scripts.status: PROJECT_DIR="$(pwd)" && FRONTEND_PORT=$(grep FRONTEND_PORT .env | cut -d'=' -f2) && BACKEND_PORT=$(grep BACKEND_PORT .env | cut -d'=' -f2) && frontend_pid=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:$FRONTEND_PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t | head -n1) && backend_pid=$(lsof -nP -iTCP:$BACKEND_PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t | head -n1) && echo "=== Frontend ===" && if [ -n "$frontend_pid" ]; then ps -p "$frontend_pid" -o pid=,ppid=,stat=,cwd=,command=; else echo "Not running"; fi && echo "=== Backend ===" && if [ -n "$backend_pid" ]; then ps -p "$backend_pid" -o pid=,ppid=,stat=,cwd=,command=; else echo "Not running"; fi && echo "=== Health Check ===" && curl -I --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$FRONTEND_PORT/ 2>&1 | head -3 && curl -sS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$BACKEND_PORT/api/health

author: Recruitment Platform Team
